summary: Frontend testing of Shamanic Elements Soul Temple 2.0 features including app rename, image fixes, GuidedAudioButton on practice pages, and auth flow.

critical.issue: Oracle router (/app/backend/routers/oracle.py lines 17-40) defines its OWN local ORACLE_CARDS list WITHOUT image_url fields. The actual oracle cards with image_url are in /app/backend/data/all_content.py but that list is NOT used by the oracle router. Fix: replace inline ORACLE_CARDS in oracle.py with the one from data/all_content.py that includes image_url

minor.issue: selected_cards mutation: card['is_reversed'] and card['position'] are set directly on ORACLE_CARDS dict references, mutating the module-level list on each request. Use copy.deepcopy or dict spread to avoid state pollution across requests.

ui_bugs.issue: Practice cards do NOT render images even though the backend data returns image_url for all 39 practices. The card component (lines 419-459) shows only a Waves icon and never renders practice.image_url. An img tag needs to be added to the card similar to how ShamanicPractices.jsx and ElementalPractices.jsx render images.

Oracle cards show no image (Eye icon only). Root cause is backend issue - oracle router uses inline ORACLE_CARDS without image_url. Frontend code correctly handles image_url (lines 179-188) - fix is on backend.
Oracle interpretation text renders raw markdown (##, **bold**) instead of formatted text. The interpretation contains markdown that should be rendered using a markdown renderer.

action_items: BUG FIX (Critical): In /app/backend/routers/oracle.py - replace the inline ORACLE_CARDS list (lines 17-40) with the image-bearing version from /app/backend/data/all_content.py - OR add image_url fields to each card in oracle.py's local list

BUG FIX (Critical): In /app/frontend/src/pages/SomaticMovement.jsx - add image rendering to practice grid cards (lines 419-459). Pattern: if (practice.image_url) render
above the card content - similar to how HeartPractices.jsx does it
BUG FIX (Medium): Fix oracle interpretation markdown rendering - wrap interpretation text in a markdown renderer or strip markdown markers
BUG FIX (Minor): Fix oracle.py ORACLE_CARDS mutation - use copy.deepcopy when sampling cards to prevent state pollution
critical_code_review_comments: oracle.py has its own ORACLE_CARDS without image_url - should use the canonical one from data/all_content.py
SomaticMovement.jsx practice cards missing image rendering despite data having image_url
oracle.py mutates ORACLE_CARDS dicts directly - causes cross-request state pollution (is_reversed/position persist)

success_rate.frontend: 75% (9 of 12 features verified; 3 features have bugs)

test_credentials: No auth needed for most tests; Google Auth and email/password forms verified visually

somatic_images_missing.fix:
Add conditional image block to practice card: if (practice.image_url) { render
} before the card body

oracle_card_images_missing.root_cause: oracle.py router (lines 17-40) defines its own local ORACLE_CARDS list with only id/name/element/meaning/reversed_meaning - no image_url. The comprehensive ORACLE_CARDS with image_url is in data/all_content.py but is not imported by oracle.py.
oracle_card_images_missing.fix: In oracle.py, remove the inline ORACLE_CARDS definition and import from data/all_content.py: 'from data.all_content import ORACLE_CARDS'
